value.rationale: Non-backtracking cover on one-hub cycle bouquets is a motivated graph-discovery statistic. At fixed edge budget the entire mean is invariant under cycle-length redistribution while the full variance has a strict positive imbalance coefficient, yielding a sharp graph-design minimization not supplied by a first-passage average.
